integrity: All conclusions derive from the manuscript proof; numerical diagnostics are illustrative and do not validate infinite-time or uniqueness assertions.
scientific_limitations: Only aligned strictly competitive coefficient structure, positive seasonal gap, nonamplifying finite pulses, resident supercriticality and exact neutral invasion; no assertion for all impulse systems or stochastic finite populations. Bibliographic equivalence remains possible.
title: Universal critical load and phase-resolved extinction at neutral invasion in periodically pulsed competition
